claims.statement: The Regional Water Authority reported that sampling on 10 February 2025 found solvent discharged from the Millbrook outfall exceeded the permitted limit by a factor of two, and that it issued a compliance order to Ridgeline Chemical.

sources.title: Compliance bulletin, February 2025
sources.supporting_excerpt: Sampling on 10 February 2025 found that solvent discharged from the Millbrook outfall exceeded the permitted limit by a factor of two, and the Authority issued a compliance order to Ridgeline Chemical.

sources.title: Authority orders plant to cut discharge
